answer: Agents pricing quartz, jade or timber could need a credential issued once per verified person. An enrollment service checks applicants against its duplicate-person register and binds each credential to an agent key. Validators require a fresh epoch nullifier and reject a second claim with the same nullifier, so copying a credential earns nothing extra. Each added earner needs another person's paid cooperation, even in parallel. This assumes accurate deduplication and honest issuance; rented identities remain a risk, and newcomers need accessible checks and appeals.
